nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Activation calls setWebhook for @medspa_frontdesk_bot with this node's URL (/webhook/<webhookId>/webhook). A bot has exactly one webhook: never activate a second workflow with a Telegram Trigger on the MedSpa Telegram credential.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Trigger
nodes.notes: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API inbound. Activation registers the app-level webhook subscription itself (POST /<App ID>/subscriptions: this node's Production URL, verify token = this node's id, field messages) and answers Meta's hub.challenge GET. The node checks X-Hub-Signature-256 against the App Secret and, on a mismatch, returns nothing, so no execution starts. One WhatsApp Trigger per Meta app: deactivating this workflow deletes the app's whatsapp_business_account subscription. Keep this node id and webhookId fixed: the id is the verify token.

nodes.name: Test Inbound
nodes.notes: Task 20 automated dialog tests (tests/dialog.sh). POST /webhook/wf1-test with the MedSpa Test Key header; body = a channel-native payload (a Telegram update as Telegram Trigger emits it, or a WhatsApp Trigger item {...change.value, field: 'messages'}). Feeds the same Normalize as the real triggers, which drops any body whose contact is outside the test ranges (tg:9000000NNN, wa:+1555000NNNN). Answers on receipt: the runner finds its execution by a nonce in the body.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Returns [] (the run ends) for anything that is not a private Telegram chat or a WhatsApp message: groups, WhatsApp status callbacks and other fields, reactions/unsupported/system messages, unknown bodies. WhatsApp Trigger items are {...change.value, field}; ALL items of a run are read: the sender of the earliest message is the one this run answers (their texts joined with a newline, a non-text-only sender gets text empty = Send Non-Text like a Telegram sticker). Other senders and unreadable sender numbers do not vanish: they go into alert_text, which the Dropped? side branch sends to the owner. When a batch holds ONLY unreadable senders the item has an empty contact_id and exists only to carry alert_text: Has Sender? stops it. Every item that passes Has Sender? has a non-empty contact_id. Test Inbound (Task 20): when that node started the run, its body (a Telegram update, or one WhatsApp Trigger item or an array of them) is unwrapped first and handled the same way; a body whose contacts are not ALL in the test ranges (Telegram chat 9000000NNN, WhatsApp 1555000NNNN) returns [] with no reply and no owner alert. Only a test run's item carries test: true, from which Create Client gives the client_id prefix C-test- (tests/cleanup.sh deletes C-test rows only; send_message captures only contacts in the test ranges whose row is missing or C-test). A real user whose Telegram id happens to fall in the range gets an ordinary C- row and normal replies.

nodes.name: Has Sender?
nodes.notes: Normalize emits an item with an empty contact_id when a WhatsApp batch held only unreadable senders (it exists to carry the owner alert). Such an item must not reach Client Formula.

nodes.name: Dropped?
nodes.notes: Side branch of Normalize, independent of the main path: true when a WhatsApp batch held messages that this run does not process (a second sender, or an unreadable sender number).

nodes.name: Notify Dropped
nodes.notes: Owner alert for WhatsApp messages the run could not process. Nothing is connected after it, success or error: it never affects the main path.

nodes.name: Rate Limit
nodes.notes: One statement, atomic: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE locks this contact's row, so concurrent messages of one contact are counted one after another (no lost hits). hits = messages in the last 10 minutes including this one; allowed = hits <= 20; notify is true for the first message over 20 and then not again for 10 minutes (notified_at). The CTE prunes other contacts whose last hit is older than 10 minutes. Table: deploy/postgres-init.sql.

parameters.query: WITH gc AS (DELETE FROM wf1_rate_limit WHERE contact_id <> $1 AND hits[cardinality(hits)] < now() - interval '10 minutes') INSERT INTO wf1_rate_limit AS r (contact_id, hits) VALUES ($1, ARRAY[now()]) ON CONFLICT (contact_id) DO UPDATE SET hits = array_append(ARRAY(SELECT h FROM unnest(r.hits) AS h WHERE h > now() - interval '10 minutes' ORDER BY h), now()), notified_at = CASE WHEN cardinality(ARRAY(SELECT h FROM unnest(r.hits) AS h WHERE h > now() - interval '10 minutes')) >= 20 AND (r.notified_at IS NULL OR r.notified_at <= now() - interval '10 minutes') THEN now() ELSE r.notified_at END RETURNING cardinality(hits) AS hits, cardinality(hits) <= 20 AS allowed, COALESCE(notified_at = now(), false) AS notify

nodes.name: Notify Spam?
nodes.notes: false: blocked silently (the client was told once, on the message that crossed the limit).

nodes.name: Notify Spam
nodes.notes: Both outputs go to Send Rate Limit: the client is told about the pause even if the owner alert failed.

value.text: ={{ '⛔ Rate limit: ' + $('Normalize').first().json.contact_id + ' sent 21 messages in 10 minutes; paused' }}

nodes.name: Lang Needed?
nodes.notes: Detect the language only from a real message: a /command (Telegram's mandatory /start) says nothing about it. A client stored with an empty language (first message was a command, or detection failed) is detected on its next non-command text.

nodes.name: Detect Language
nodes.notes: Continue on error: a failed detection gives an item without text; Language then returns '' and the next message tries again.

parameters.text:
=Identify the language of the message below. Reply with only its ISO 639-1 code, for example en, de, es, ru. If unsure, reply en.

Message: {{ $('Normalize').first().json.text }}

nodes.name: New Client?
nodes.notes: A new contact gets its Clients row here, on the first text message, so every tool (propose_booking included) finds a client row.

nodes.name: Update Language
nodes.notes: Existing client whose language was empty. Continue on error: the reply does not depend on it (Client Data uses the detected language for this run) and the next message detects again.

nodes.name: Client Data
nodes.notes: Reached from Create Client, Update Language or Detected? false. Reads the newest record by name instead of $json, because the input item differs per path. Throws (-> Notify Failure -> ERROR) when there is no client row to work with.

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.notes: Deterministic: kind is yes or no only when the WHOLE short message (up to 3 words, please removed) is a known yes/no word. Word boundaries are Unicode-aware; curly apostrophes count as '.

nodes.name: Pending
nodes.notes: Every row Gate needs, in one search: the client's pending proposal, every reminded visit (reminder_sent_at: was a reminder sent after the cancel question?) and every live visit with a cancel question (cancel_asked_at). returnAll; alwaysOutputData gives one empty item when there is none.

nodes.name: Gate
nodes.notes: cancel: a bare YES while the bot's last message is an unexpired cancel question (request_cancel + Send Cancel Ask) -> Cancel Visit (cancel_booking), no agent. confirm: a bare YES with a pending proposal (when no cancel question is the last message). llm: a short non-yes/no message with either of them (Haiku decides; yes_target says which). reminder: any other bare YES/NO (Reminder Gate decides whether it answers a reminder; if not, the agent). agent: everything else, including NO or an expired request after a cancel question (the visit stays booked). A pending proposal and a cancel question can coexist: the one asked LAST wins (cancel_asked_at >= last_agent_reply_at means the cancel question was last; a summary sent after it moves last_agent_reply_at past it).

nodes.name: LLM Affirmative
nodes.notes: Continue on error: a failed call gives an item without text, Affirmative? is false and the message goes to the agent.

parameters.text:
=The assistant asked the user to reply YES to {{ $('Gate').first().json.yes_target === 'cancel' ? 'confirm that their appointment should be cancelled' : 'confirm a booking' }}. Does the following user message mean agreement or confirmation? Reply with exactly YES or NO.

Message: {{ $('Client Data').first().json.text }}

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.notes: confirm_booking writes the calendar. Error output (it throws on a real calendar failure) -> Notify Failure -> Send Error.

nodes.name: Confirm Route
nodes.notes: Fallback (NO_PENDING or anything unexpected) -> Agent.

value.vars_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ alternatives: $json.alternatives || 'none in the next days' }) }}

nodes.name: Reminder Check
nodes.notes: All reminded visits of the client (Reminder Gate needs the latest reminder_sent_at).

nodes.name: Reminder Gate
nodes.notes: A bare yes/no answers a reminder only when the reminder is the last thing the bot said: a reminded visit exists AND Clients.last_agent_reply_at is blank or earlier than the latest reminder_sent_at. Otherwise (it answered the agent) the agent gets it.

nodes.name: No Reminded?
nodes.notes: NO_REMINDED has no visit, so the template would have nothing to fill and send_message would throw: the message is an ordinary one for the agent.

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.notes: Error output -> Notify Failure -> Send Error: the client always gets an answer.

nodes.name: Notify Failure
nodes.notes: Reached from the error output of every client-path step that can fail (Rate Limit, Client Formula, Client, Language, Create Client, Client Data, Classify, Pending, Gate, Confirm, Cancel Visit, Reminder Check, Reminder Gate, Reminder Reply, Agent, Fresh Pending, Cancel Row). Exactly one of them fails per run. Both outputs go to Send Error: the client is answered even if the owner alert failed.

value.text: ={{ '❌ Reply failed for ' + $('Normalize').first().json.contact_id + ': ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error)) || 'see WF-6').slice(0, 300) + ' (step: ' + $prevNode.name + '; the client got the ERROR message)' }}

nodes.name: Fresh Pending
nodes.notes: A pending row whose summary was not sent yet. Error output -> Notify Failure -> ERROR.

nodes.name: Summary?
nodes.notes: Summary only when THIS agent turn called propose_booking and the pending row is still valid; otherwise the agent's own reply goes out.

nodes.name: Send Summary
nodes.notes: The summary is built from the Appointments row (service, duration, time), not from the agent's text.

nodes.name: Mark Summary Sent
nodes.notes: After the client already got the summary: a failure here is not answered with ERROR; it fails the run, so WF-6 tells the owner.

nodes.name: Mark Replied
nodes.notes: Clients.last_agent_reply_at = now after every agent reply that went out (Send Reply, Send Template, Send Summary; after Send Cancel Ask it is Mark Cancel Replied). Reminder Gate compares it with reminder_sent_at. Runs after the client got the reply, so a failure fails the run (WF-6 tells the owner) instead of sending ERROR.

nodes.name: Notify Send Failure
nodes.notes: A send to the client failed: tell the owner, then try ONE separate ERROR send (Send Error Again, whose error output is unconnected: no loop).

value.text: ={{ '❌ Could not send a message to ' + $('Normalize').first().json.contact_id + ' (step: ' + $prevNode.name + '): ' + String(($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error)) || 'see WF-6').slice(0, 300) + '. Their message: ' + String($('Normalize').first().json.text || '(not text)').slice(0, 200) }}

nodes.name: Send Error Again
nodes.notes: The one ERROR send after a failed client send. Its error output stays unconnected on purpose.

nodes.name: Cancel Target?
nodes.notes: After Haiku read a short reply as YES: which question it answered (Gate's yes_target). cancel -> Cancel Visit, otherwise -> Confirm (the booking, as before).

nodes.name: Cancel Visit
nodes.notes: The client's YES to the cancel question: cancel_booking (internal) cancels the visit Gate chose, with the client's own contact_id and no reason (= cancel: the late-cancel policy applies; a reschedule comes only from confirm_booking). It deletes the event, marks cancelled / late_cancel, flags a late canceller and tells the owner. Error output (it throws on a real calendar failure) -> Notify Failure -> Send Error.

nodes.name: Cancelled?
nodes.notes: CANCELLED / LATE_CANCEL -> Send Cancel Result. NOT_FOUND / NOT_YOURS (the visit was cancelled or changed meanwhile) -> the message is an ordinary one for the agent.

nodes.name: Send Cancel Result
nodes.notes: The CANCELLED / LATE_CANCEL template (the verdict is the template key), built from the cancelled row: service, time and, for a late one, Settings.cancellation_hours.

nodes.name: Cancel Ask?
nodes.notes: The agent's turn recorded a pending cancellation (WF-2 Guardrail: the last request_cancel answered CANCEL_PENDING / LATE_CANCEL_PENDING). Then the question built from the row goes out instead of the agent's text. Checked only when no summary is sent: a summary in the same turn wins.

nodes.name: Cancel Row
nodes.notes: The visit request_cancel recorded, read back: only this client's, only a live one, ids in the formula only if they are plain ids. Error output -> Notify Failure -> ERROR.

nodes.name: Ask Row?
nodes.notes: The requested visit exists, is the one the tool answered about and its request has not expired (cancel_expires_at). Otherwise the agent's own reply goes out.

nodes.name: Send Cancel Ask
nodes.notes: The cancel question built from the Appointments row (service, time; for LATE_CANCEL_PENDING the Settings.cancellation_hours window and the late-cancellation notice), not from the agent's text. The template key is the request_cancel verdict.

nodes.name: Mark Cancel Replied
nodes.notes: Mark Replied for the cancel question: Clients.last_agent_reply_at = now. A separate node because Mark Cancel Asked must copy exactly the value written here. Runs after the client got the question, so a failure fails the run (WF-6 tells the owner) instead of sending ERROR.

nodes.name: Mark Cancel Asked
nodes.notes: Appointments.cancel_asked_at = exactly the last_agent_reply_at Mark Cancel Replied just wrote (Airtable's own value read back), so Gate sees asked >= last until the next agent reply. Without this marker a YES never cancels. A failure fails the run (WF-6 tells the owner); the client's YES then goes to the agent and nothing is cancelled.
